nodes.label: Subagent (TaskTool) Pattern
nodes.rationale: Delegates complex work to specialized sub-agents for separation of concerns; the main orchestrator agent focuses on coordination and planning while sub-agents provide deep domain expertise in specific areas (codebase exploration, web research, dependency analysis).

nodes.label: Tech Due Diligence Assistant (Orchestrator)
nodes.rationale: A multi-agent system that helps evaluate software projects by combining codebase analysis (structure, dependencies, patterns, technical debt) with web research (documentation, alternatives, benchmarks, ecosystem). Uses write_todos for planning and Task/TaskOutput tools for delegation.

nodes.label: Task / TaskOutput Delegation Tools
nodes.rationale: Task tool initiates delegation of a unit of work to a specialized sub-agent; TaskOutput tool receives the result. Together they form a request-response delegation protocol that decouples the orchestrator from sub-agent implementation details.

nodes.label: write_todos Planning Tool
nodes.rationale: Enables structured task planning by breaking complex due diligence tasks into smaller, trackable steps before delegation. Injected by TodoListInterceptor into the orchestrator agent.

nodes.label: Markdown-based Agent Definition
nodes.rationale: Declarative, file-based definition for simplicity and ease of authoring. Agent specs stored as Markdown files with YAML front matter containing name, description, and comma-separated tools list. Registered via TaskToolsBuilder.addAgentResource() or addAgentDirectory(). Trade-off: simple and readable but limited to declarative configuration.

nodes.label: API-based (Programmatic) Agent Definition
nodes.rationale: Programmatic definition via ReactAgent.builder() for maximum flexibility: custom system prompts, dynamic tool selection, and Java-level configuration. Registered via TaskToolsBuilder.subAgent(). Trade-off: more complex to define but offers fine-grained control over agent behavior.

hyperedges.label: TaskToolsBuilder Bridges Markdown and API Agent Definitions
